newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Power go 10-3 against an Irish trained Aintree win.
newsitem.headline: Power go 10-3 against an Irish trained Aintree win.

text.p: Ireland's Paddy Power bookmaker firm on Friday offered odds of 10-3 against an Irish trained runner winning Saturday's Aintree Grand National at Liverpool.

Power said in a statement that it was offering odds of 5-1 against a woman trainer saddling the winner and odds of 10-1 against Britian's Jenny Pitman adding the Aintree title to the Irish Grand National title she landed at Fairyhouse last Monday with Mudahim.
The company said it was offering 250-1 against the Aintree Grand National being declared void due to a false start.
Power said it was offering 500-1 against only one horse finishing the Aintree National and the same odds against a streaker jumping Beecher's Brook during the race.
